# Kenney asset collections

These CC0 collections are vendored intact as a prototyping library for the
Dross playground. Assets remain grouped by their published kit so their
identity, provenance, and licensing never depend on filename conventions.

- `furniture-kit/`: Furniture Kit 2.0, 140 GLB models
- `nature-kit/`: Nature Kit 2.1, 329 GLB models

Each collection contains its own publisher-supplied license and a README with
the official source URL and source-archive checksum. Only GLB models and
Godot's corresponding import metadata are retained; the original ZIP archives
and redundant formats are not committed.

The source models retain Kenney's embedded materials. ThumpDemo scenes should
apply LoSpec500-compatible material overrides where needed to maintain the
demo's art direction without altering this recognizable source collection.
